FAQ

Questions about hostel software

What features does a hostel management system need?

A complete hostel system covers room and bed allocation, rent and fee billing, mess management, gate pass and visitor control, complaints, inventory and owner dashboards. Sarvlekh combines all of these in one connected platform.

Can it handle multiple hostel branches?

Yes. Every branch runs on the same system with separate rooms, staff and ledgers, while the owner sees one consolidated view of occupancy, collections and expenses.

Do parents get notifications?

Yes. Guardians receive WhatsApp or SMS alerts for payments, late entry, leave requests and notices.

Can the hostel system be customised to our way of working?

Yes. Every Sarvlekh system is shaped around your workflow — modules, roles, reports and approvals are configured with you, not imposed on you.

Can Sarvlekh connect the hostel system to Tally and GST?

Yes. Sales, purchase and payment entries flow into Tally automatically and GST-ready invoices are generated from the same data.

How quickly can we go live?

A focused first release usually goes live in weeks. We start with the modules that remove the most manual work and expand in stages.
